summary: MSD Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Senior Secured Credit Agreement. The amendment increased the limit on incurrence of Shorter Term Unsecured Indebtedness from $200 million to $600 million. No other material terms changed. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is purely a financing arrangement update without triggering any special-situations event.
